    if match:

    # Extract Employee Level
    match = re.search(r'Employee Level:\s*(\S+)', text)
    if match:
        claim_data['employee_level'] = match.group(1)
    
    # Extract Department
    match = re.search(r'Department:\s*(.+?)(?:\n|Destination:)', text)
    if match:
        claim_data['department'] = match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Extract Destination
    match = re.search(r'Destination:\s*(.+?)(?:\n|Trip Start:)', text)
    if match:
        claim_data['destination'] = match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Extract Trip Start
    match = re.search(r'Trip Start:\s*(\S+)', text)
    if match:
        claim_data['trip_start'] = match.group(1)
    
    # Extract Trip End
    match = re.search(r'Trip End:\s*(\S+)', text)
    if match:
        claim_data['trip_end'] = match.group(1)
    
    # Extract Nights
    match = re.search(r'Nights:\s*(\d+)', text)
    if match:
        claim_data['nights'] = int(match.group(1))
    
    # Extract Total Amount
    match = re.search(r'Total Amount:\s*CNY\s*([\d,]+\.?\d*)', text)
    if match:
        amount_str = match.group(1).replace(',', '')
        claim_data['total_amount'] = float(amount_str)
    
    # Extract expense items
    items = []
    # Pattern to match expense rows
    pattern = r'(\d+)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(\S+(?:\s+\S+)*?)\s+(Accommodation|Meals|Transportation|Communication|Miscellaneous)\s+([\d,]+\.?\d*)\s+(.+?)(?=\n\d+\s+\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\nApplicant|$)'
    
    matches = re.finditer(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
    for match in matches:
        item = {
            'no': int(match.group(1)),
            'date': match.group(2),
            'city': match.group(3).strip(),
            'category': match.group(4),
            'amount': float(match.group(5).replace(',', '')),
            'description': match.group(6).strip()
        }
        items.append(item)
    
    claim_data['items'] = items
    
    return claim_data
